semiconductor_relevance: High — Plasway Technologies GmbH provides specialized plasma processing equipment crucial for semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Plasway Technologies GmbH is a key player in the semiconductor equipment sector, focusing on plasma processes such as Atomic Layer Processing (ALP). They offer advanced tools like the FALP® 300 for Plasma Enhanced Layer Deposition and Atomic Layer Etching, supporting the fabrication of semiconductor devices.
